verdict.rationale: BAMF is a German federal migration and refugee authority with an informational website, not a software product or user-account service. A user cannot switch providers and 'leave', so a data-export-and-exit portability story is a category error here. Nothing in the evidence shows BAMF offering any self-service data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
